entities.summary: The Yosafat Kobrynskyi National Museum of Hutsulshchyna and Pokuttia Folk Art is a museum in Kolomyia, Ukraine with a collection of more than 50,000 objects documenting the history and folk culture of Hutsulshchyna and Pokuttia regions.
